description: This header file defines interfaces for CA (Certificate Authority) entity creation functions, including functions to create CA entities with or without encoding. It contains include guards and references to external handles and encodings used for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: AnscCreateCAEntity
methods.description: Creates a CA entity with provided context, reserved handle, and certificate handle.

methods.name: AnscCreateCAEntityWithEncoding
methods.description: Creates a CA entity with provided context, reserved handle, encoded certificate, and its length.
